by
  intro n
  let f := ProbabilityTheory.mgf X μ
  have hf : differentiableAt f 0 :=
    by apply ProbabilityTheory.mgf_differentiableAt; exact h
  have hdiff : ∀ n, differentiableAt (fun t : ℝ => ∫ (ω : Ω), (X ω)^n * exp (t * X ω) ∂μ) 0 :=
    by intro n; apply MeasureTheory.integralDifferentiableAt; intro t; intro ht;
      apply MeasureTheory.integral_cong; intro ω; rw [exp_zero]; simp
  let f'' := fun t : ℝ => ∫ (ω : Ω), (X ω)^n * exp (t * X ω) ∂μ
  have hf'' : differentiableAt f'' 0 := by apply hdiff n
  have hderiv : iteratedDeriv n f 0 = iteratedDeriv n f'' 0 :=
    by rw [iteratedDeriv_eq_iteratedDeriv_at_0]; rw [iteratedDeriv_eq_iteratedDeriv_at_0]
  have hderiv2 : iteratedDeriv n f'' 0 = ∫ (ω : Ω), (X ω)^n ∂μ :=
    by apply MeasureTheory.integralDifferentiableAt_iteratedDeriv; intro t; intro ht;
      apply MeasureTheory.integral_cong; intro ω; rw [exp_zero]; simp
  rw [hderiv]; rw [hderiv2]; refl
